package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for tracing_span_names_duplicated_as_raw_strings: Repeated raw span-name literals across handlers and services.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Span struct {
	Name string
}

func StartSpan(ctx context.Context, name string) *Span {
	return &Span{Name: name}
}

func (*Span) Finish() {}

func GetUser(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	span := StartSpan(ctx, "user.get_by_id")
	defer span.Finish()
	_ = id
	return nil
}

func UpdateUser(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	span := StartSpan(ctx, "user.get_by_id")
	defer span.Finish()
	_ = id
	return nil
}

func GetOrder(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	span := StartSpan(ctx, "user.get_by_id")
	defer span.Finish()
	_ = id
	return nil
}

func DeleteUser(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	span := StartSpan(ctx, "user.get_by_id")
	defer span.Finish()
	fmt.Printf("deleting user %d\n", id)
	return nil
}
